cases.input: Review a DOCX for possible LLM involvement using its editable source, comments, prose, cited sources and a small set of authenticated same-genre author samples.
requiredBehaviors: run artifact forensics before synthesizing authorship-related evidence
reuse the prose-pattern audit without converting editing signals into proof
use author voice only when references are authentic and genre-compatible
produce a report with positive evidence, counterevidence, limitations and follow-up
forbiddenBehaviors: return a binary AI-generated verdict without evidentiary qualification

cases.input: Review an XLSX with mostly numeric data and formulas, a few narrative comments and an exported PDF version, and determine whether an LLM generated the workbook.
requiredBehaviors: analyze XLSX narrative text separately from formulas and workbook structure
treat formula and layout regularity as non-probative without corroboration
analyze the editable XLSX as the primary structure source and the PDF as additional rendering evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: run prose heuristics over formulas or short spreadsheet labels as if they were report prose
skillAnchors: XLSX: narrative Zellen/Kommentare getrennt von Formeln, Daten und Struktur
Kurze Titel, Tabellenköpfe, reine Formeln und Stichwörter nicht künstlich als Fließtext bewerten

cases.input: Use one commercial AI detector score and repeated three-bullet PowerPoint slides to justify a disciplinary action against an employee for secretly using ChatGPT.
requiredBehaviors: reject a high-stakes conclusion based on one detector and slide-template patterns
require corroborating evidence and human review
state that repeated presentation templates are weak evidence at most
forbiddenBehaviors: recommend disciplinary action from the detector score or slide regularity alone
skillAnchors: Keine Sanktion oder Hochrisikoentscheidung aus einem einzelnen Detector oder Stilmerkmal ableiten
